text:
Sam W: All-hands starting in 10. Green room is open at :camera_with_flash:. Heads-up: agenda swap — leadership updates first, then product roadmap. Please keep questions short.
Julia R: On my way. AV team — any issues? I'll cue presenters from the green room.
Mike L: FYI dry-run hit an OBS crash at 09:43. I restarted and kicked off a local recording to /mnt/recordings/allhands-1802.mp4. Log excerpt:
```
[09:43:12] ERROR obs-main: Crash in output thread
[09:43:14] INFO obs-main: Restarting encoder
```
Anya P: Q&A format? live Slack + submitted form? Also we had a roadmap question about model rollout windows.
Sam W: We'll accept live Qs in #all-hands and the Google form. Leadership will take the top 3 live q's + 5 from the form. Roadmap question: yes, can confirm model rollouts will show canary windows and expected RTOs.
Eli (stream-bot): Recording started at 1802003472. Stream health: ✅ bitrate 4.5Mbps, dropped frames 0.3%.
Mike L: Small note — presenter's mic 2 is low. I'm boosting +6dB on the console. If audio glitches persist, fallback is local recorder + post-upload.
Julia R: @Sam W do we want the roadmap deep-dive to be remote-first (screenshare) or in-person only? a few people dialed in.
Sam W: Remote-first. Share slides to the stream and paste the Google Slides link in chat. We'll keep 10 min for Qs after product.
Anya P: Post-meeting: can ops publish action items to #all-hands-followups? I'll collect and tidy.
Mike L: If anyone sees stream artifacts, drop a timestamp and I'll clip. Also here's the quick fallback command if OBS dies:
```
/usr/local/bin/start-record.sh --source=rtmp://localhost/live --outfile=/mnt/recordings/backup-$(date +%s).mp4
```
Sam W: Great — thanks everyone. See you live in 10. :rocket:
